title: Aperture Jitter Measurement
text: Measure aperture jitter of periodic signals, 1 input, 1 output; {Frequency} sets the input clock frequency 1e6, {Recommended min. simulation stop time} sets the minimum time the simulation must run for meaningful result, {Min}, {Max} and {Hold off time (s)} sets the delay before measurement analysis. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Frequency
params.values: Input clock frequency 1e6 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Recommended min. simulation stop time
params.values: Minimum time the simulation must run for meaningful result 9.901e-05 (default) | scalar

params.name: Min
params.values: Minimum value of clock signal 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Max
params.values: Maximum value of clock signal 1 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delay before measurement analysis 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar
